column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 11 (M23011): serangan rudal + Wildhunt, "Horn System" diaktifkan.
# Tetap Inggris: Wildhunt, Nyto/Nytos, Sinbreaker, "Horn System", Remolding Pattern,
# OTs-14, Voymastina, Klukai, Belka, Mechty, Cheyanne, Faelynn, Alva, Igla, Lentine,
# Vasily, Wulfgar, Mokosh, Mangi Security, The Elmo, Squad 404, Monsoon Squad,
# Oathguards, Doll, Frame, Neural cloud.
# Catatan: satu baris di file Inggris masih tertinggal berbahasa Mandarin
# (终于来了吗？ = "Akhirnya datang juga?") — diterjemahkan langsung ke Indonesia.
(After the Doll surprise attack team led by Igla was repelled by Mokosh, Mangi Security's attacks seemed to lose their organization.)
column2: (Setelah tim serangan mendadak Doll pimpinan Igla dipukul mundur Mokosh, serangan Mangi Security seakan kehilangan penataannya.)

column1: (For a whole night, the other party continued to dispatch small teams and drone combat groups to carry out scattered attacks. But compared to the previous offensives, the attacks of these teams were obviously not to scale and completely disorganized, and were soon defeated by the Doll squads again.)
column2: (Semalam suntuk, pihak lawan terus mengirim tim kecil dan kelompok tempur drone untuk melancarkan serangan sporadis. Tapi dibanding serangan sebelumnya, serbuan tim-tim ini jelas tidak seberapa dan sama sekali tak tertata, dan cepat dipatahkan lagi oleh regu Doll.)

column1: (A night passed. On the tactical sand table, the red dots marked as the enemy gradually shrank in the direction away from Mokosh. And looking at the victorious battle reports one by one, Vasily's tense expression finally loosened a little.)
column2: (Semalam berlalu. Di meja pasir taktis, titik-titik merah penanda musuh perlahan menyusut menjauhi Mokosh. Dan melihat laporan kemenangan satu per satu, ekspresi tegang Vasily akhirnya sedikit mengendur.)

column1: Commander, the operation to defeat Igla's squad seems to be highly effective. The battle situation seems to be developing in the direction we expected.
column2: Komandan, operasi mengalahkan regu Igla sepertinya sangat efektif. Jalannya pertempuran tampak berkembang ke arah yang kita harapkan.

column1: Mhm. Last night, the enemy's actions were indeed a bit messy, but we can't relax just yet.
column2: Mhm. Semalam gerakan musuh memang agak berantakan, tapi kita belum boleh lengah.

column1: The enemy might just want us to lower our guard, or control our defensive rhythm.
column2: Musuh mungkin justru ingin kita menurunkan kewaspadaan, atau mengendalikan irama pertahanan kita.

column1: Continue to maintain detection, all Doll squads report the enemy situation.
column2: Terus pertahankan deteksi, seluruh regu Doll laporkan situasi musuh.

column1: Commander, the enemy on the outskirts of the East Line of the battlefield has temporarily suspended their offensive and is moving towards the camp. No enemy engagement targets are seen within the field of vision.
column2: Komandan, musuh di pinggiran Garis Timur medan tempur untuk sementara menghentikan serangan dan bergerak ke arah kemah. Tidak terlihat sasaran musuh dalam jangkauan pandang.

column1: Most of the enemy on the West Line has retreated behind cover. There is still sporadic crossfire in some areas, but the enemy is showing signs of retreating.
column2: Sebagian besar musuh di Garis Barat sudah mundur ke balik perlindungan. Masih ada baku tembak sporadis di beberapa area, tapi musuh menunjukkan tanda-tanda mundur.

column1: Squad 404 Team 2 reports, in the peripheral city area, the enemy currently has no action.
column2: Squad 404 Tim 2 melapor, di kawasan kota pinggiran, musuh saat ini tidak bergerak.

column1: Monsoon Squad reports, the drone aerial strike has been defeated, and no new enemy forces have appeared.
column2: Monsoon Squad melapor, serangan udara drone sudah dipatahkan, dan belum muncul pasukan musuh baru.

column1: However, the anti-vehicle and anti-personnel minefields on the periphery of the west front have all been exhausted in the engagement.
column2: Namun ladang ranjau anti-kendaraan dan anti-personel di pinggiran front barat semuanya sudah habis terpakai dalam pertempuran.

column1: Understood. Cheyanne, you will assist in providing long-range support for the front line on the periphery of the west front later. While Team 2 provides mobile support to the periphery, also pay attention to that area at all times.
column2: Dimengerti. Cheyanne, nanti kau bantu memberi dukungan jarak jauh untuk garis depan di pinggiran front barat. Sementara Tim 2 memberi dukungan bergerak ke pinggiran, awasi juga area itu setiap saat.

column1: Cheyanne, received.
column2: Cheyanne, diterima.

column1: Squad 2, received.
column2: Regu 2, diterima.

column1: (Judging from the reports of each squad, the enemy's attack is indeed slowing down. This is certainly advantageous for Mokosh's battle situation, but I can't help but ponder the reason for the enemy's sudden change.)
column2: (Dari laporan tiap regu, serangan musuh memang melambat. Ini jelas menguntungkan situasi Mokosh, tapi aku tak bisa berhenti memikirkan alasan perubahan mendadak mereka.)

column1: (Before Igla's squad attacked, the enemy's command still had some degree of organization. After the squad led by Igla retreated, the battlefield completely devolved into chaos—judging by this, the commander the enemy previously relied on was probably the commander of Igla's squad, Lentine.)
column2: (Sebelum regu Igla menyerang, komando musuh masih cukup tertata. Setelah regu pimpinan Igla mundur, medan tempur benar-benar berubah kacau—dari situ, komandan yang selama ini diandalkan musuh kemungkinan besar adalah komandan regu Igla, yaitu Lentine.)

column1: (Since it's her, she definitely wouldn't just simply retreat. The reduction in the scale of the subsequent attacks seems more like a deliberate disguise to make it look like they are still attacking.)
column2: (Kalau memang dia, dia jelas tidak akan mundur begitu saja. Menyusutnya skala serangan berikutnya lebih terasa seperti samaran yang disengaja agar terlihat mereka masih menyerang.)

column1: (Of course, there is another possibility—someone more composed than Lentine is taking over the new tactical command.)
column2: (Tentu ada kemungkinan lain—seseorang yang lebih tenang daripada Lentine mengambil alih komando taktis yang baru.)

column1: (The enemy is trying to test Mokosh's defense line with small-scale offensives, looking for flaws in our every move.)
column2: (Musuh berusaha menguji garis pertahanan Mokosh dengan serangan skala kecil, mencari celah di setiap gerakan kami.)

column1: (In any case, the battlefield situation has briefly eased, and Mokosh has gained precious breathing room. We have a mountain of things to do—worrying too much about the enemy's trump cards will only do more harm than good.)
column2: (Bagaimanapun, situasi medan tempur sempat mereda, dan Mokosh mendapat waktu bernapas yang berharga. Ada segunung hal yang harus kami kerjakan—terlalu mencemaskan kartu truf musuh justru lebih banyak ruginya.)

column1: Commander, are you thinking about the subsequent tactics? Is there a problem?
column2: Komandan, Anda sedang memikirkan taktik selanjutnya? Ada masalah?

column1: Before the enemy's next big move, let's consolidate our current achievements first.
column2: Sebelum gebrakan besar musuh berikutnya, mari kita kukuhkan dulu capaian kita sekarang.

column1: Next, Mokosh will soon face more fierce attacks. Both the aerial and ground defense lines will face more severe challenges.
column2: Berikutnya, Mokosh akan segera menghadapi serangan yang lebih ganas. Garis pertahanan udara maupun darat akan menghadapi tantangan yang lebih berat.

column1: Wulfgar, I'll leave the manual operation of the anti-aircraft system to the artillery team later.
column2: Wulfgar, pengoperasian manual sistem anti-pesawat nanti kuserahkan pada tim artileri.

column1: No problem, but the boys' training against aerial targets is still insufficient.
column2: Tidak masalah, tapi latihan anak-anak melawan sasaran udara masih kurang.

column1: Don't worry, I will send Dolls to assist you.
column2: Tenang, aku akan mengirim Doll untuk membantu kalian.

column1: In addition, synchronize with all ground combat units and neighboring settlements to strengthen vigilance. Pay special attention to whether mobile firepower reinforcements appear on the pathways between Mokosh and the outskirts of various settlements.
column2: Selain itu, selaraskan dengan semua unit tempur darat dan permukiman tetangga untuk memperketat kewaspadaan. Perhatikan khusus apakah muncul bala bantuan daya tembak bergerak di jalur antara Mokosh dan pinggiran berbagai permukiman.

column1: Yes! Defense orders have been synchronized!
column2: Siap! Perintah pertahanan sudah diselaraskan!

column1: (With the orders issued, the atmosphere in the command room became tense again. Vasily couldn't help but show a bit of anxiety.)
column2: (Setelah perintah diturunkan, suasana ruang komando kembali menegang. Vasily tak kuasa menyembunyikan sedikit kecemasannya.)

column1: Commander, what on earth are they planning to do next?
column2: Komandan, sebenarnya apa yang mereka rencanakan selanjutnya?

column1: Since they've already run through their conventional tactics once, I think it's time... they unveiled some new tricks.
column2: Karena taktik konvensional mereka sudah dijalankan sekali, kurasa sudah waktunya... mereka membuka jurus baru.

column1: (Sure enough, less than an hour later, a piercing air raid siren suddenly sounded in the command room.)
column2: (Benar saja, belum sampai sejam kemudian, sirene serangan udara melengking tiba-tiba berbunyi di ruang komando.)

column1: Commander, a large-scale missile signal has been detected over the central district!
column2: Komandan, terdeteksi sinyal rudal skala besar di atas distrik pusat!

column1: 终于来了吗？
column2: Akhirnya datang juga?

column1: Voymastina, immediately activate the Sinbreaker for aerial interception!
column2: Voymastina, segera aktifkan Sinbreaker untuk pencegatan udara!

column1: OTs-14, dispatch the Heavy Weapons Team to assist with the interception! Monsoon, Squad 404, don't slack on synchronous ground alert!
column2: OTs-14, kerahkan Heavy Weapons Team untuk membantu pencegatan! Monsoon, Squad 404, jangan kendur di siaga darat serentak!

column1: (Orders were relayed against the clock in the command room. As the orders were passed down, the Doll squads and the Oathguards on the battlefield became active once more.)
column2: (Perintah diteruskan berkejaran dengan waktu di ruang komando. Begitu perintah turun, regu Doll dan Oathguards di medan tempur kembali bergerak.)

column1: (Above the sand table, projections of simulated missiles crashed into the aerial defense net, while on the synchronized broadcast screens, the intercepted missiles exploded one by one in midair.)
column2: (Di atas meja pasir, proyeksi rudal simulasi menghantam jaring pertahanan udara, sementara di layar siaran yang selaras, rudal-rudal yang tercegat meledak satu per satu di udara.)

column1: (Boom— Boom—)
column2: (Buum— Buum—)

column1: (Even though the explosions occurred hundreds of meters in the air, still far from the underground city and the command center, the continuous shockwaves seemed to transmit unceasingly through the screens, the sound of the wind, and the trembling earth.)
column2: (Meski ledakannya terjadi ratusan meter di udara, masih jauh dari kota bawah tanah dan pusat komando, gelombang kejut yang beruntun itu seolah merambat tanpa henti lewat layar, deru angin, dan bumi yang bergetar.)

column1: (Everyone clenched their fists, half-holding their breath, as they uneasily watched those violently blooming sparks, praying they wouldn't fall to the earth.)
column2: (Semua orang mengepalkan tinju, setengah menahan napas, menonton gelisah percikan api yang mekar dahsyat itu, berdoa agar tak satu pun jatuh ke bumi.)

column1: (And right at that moment, another layer of alarms suddenly blared—)
column2: (Dan tepat saat itu, satu lapis sirene lagi mendadak meraung—)

column1: Commander, fast-moving heat sources detected on the ground!
column2: Komandan, terdeteksi sumber panas bergerak cepat di permukaan!

column1: The other party is crossing the disabled minefield, and has, has broken through the West Line outer area defense line!
column2: Pihak lawan sedang melintasi ladang ranjau yang sudah tidak berfungsi, dan sudah, sudah menembus garis pertahanan area luar Garis Barat!

column1: As expected—
column2: Sudah kuduga—

column1: (Due to the loss of the minefield's obstruction, the west side front line was broken through by enemy troops in an instant. I quickly looked at the battlefield broadcast on the screen.)
column2: (Karena hilangnya hambatan ladang ranjau, garis depan sisi barat ditembus pasukan musuh dalam sekejap. Cepat kualihkan pandangan ke siaran medan tempur di layar.)

column1: (However, the young man operated in front of the screen several times, but the drone was never able to capture the enemy's appearance. In the lens, there were only countless fleeting dark shadows and blood splashing everywhere.)
column2: (Namun, pemuda itu berkali-kali mengutak-atik di depan layar, tapi drone sama sekali tak berhasil menangkap wujud musuh. Di lensa hanya ada bayangan-bayangan gelap yang berkelebat tak terhitung dan darah muncrat di mana-mana.)

column1: Sorry, Commander, the enemy, the enemy's movements are just too fast! The reconnaissance drone can't capture them!
column2: Maaf, Komandan, musuhnya, gerakan musuhnya terlalu cepat! Drone pengintai tidak bisa menangkapnya!

column1: Tsk... An enemy so fast they can't be captured, huh.
column2: Cih... Musuh yang begitu cepat sampai tak bisa tertangkap, ya.

column1: (A familiar feeling surfaced in my mind, and a sense of foreboding gradually grew stronger.)
column2: (Perasaan yang akrab muncul di benakku, dan firasat buruk itu perlahan menguat.)

column1: (I immediately issued orders to all squads.)
column2: (Aku langsung menurunkan perintah ke semua regu.)

column1: All Doll squads, quickly confirm the status of the enemy target! The enemy's strength may be on par with Nytos or Third-generation Dolls, so maintain distance and engage with caution!
column2: Seluruh regu Doll, cepat pastikan status sasaran musuh! Kekuatan musuh mungkin setara Nyto atau Doll generasi ketiga, jaga jarak dan bertempurlah dengan hati-hati!

column1: 404 reporting back! We have made long-range contact with the enemy!
column2: 404 melapor! Kami sudah kontak jarak jauh dengan musuh!

column1: According to preliminary engagement assessment, the opponent's strength is close to an advanced Nyto!
column2: Menurut penilaian awal pertempuran, kekuatan lawan mendekati Nyto tingkat lanjut!

column1: (Bang bang bang bang bang bang bang bang—)
column2: (Dor dor dor dor dor dor dor dor—)

column1: (The sound of fierce crossfire came from the comms channel. At the same time, a group of agile and terrifying figures, like demonic beasts from mythology, appeared in the center of the screen—)
column2: (Suara baku tembak sengit terdengar dari kanal komunikasi. Bersamaan itu, sekelompok sosok gesit dan mengerikan, bagai binatang iblis dari mitologi, muncul di tengah layar—)

column1: (They leaped several stories high and dashed at high speeds, breezing past the obstacles on the battlefield, and attacked visible sentry posts with immense firepower.)
column2: (Mereka melompat setinggi beberapa lantai dan melesat kencang, melewati rintangan medan tempur seolah tanpa beban, dan menyerang pos jaga yang terlihat dengan daya tembak besar.)

column1: (And even when hit by defensive fire, they managed to survive relying on their tough physical structure and astonishing judgment.)
column2: (Dan bahkan saat terkena tembakan pertahanan, mereka tetap bertahan berkat struktur tubuh yang liat dan naluri yang mencengangkan.)

column1: Commander, target confirmed, syncing to the command center now!
column2: Komandan, sasaran terkonfirmasi, sedang dikirim ke pusat komando!

column1: No mistake, it's those guys who fought with Team 2!
column2: Tidak salah lagi, ini makhluk yang dulu bertempur dengan Tim 2!

column1: (The warnings from Faelynn, Alva, and Squad 404's 2nd Team explode in my ears. I immediately grab my communication terminal.)
column2: (Peringatan dari Faelynn, Alva, dan Tim 2 Squad 404 meledak di telingaku. Langsung kusambar terminal komunikasiku.)

column1: Oathguard teams, evade immediately! I repeat, Oathguard teams, evade immediately!
column2: Seluruh tim Oathguard, segera mengelak! Kuulangi, seluruh tim Oathguard, segera mengelak!

column1: The enemy elite forces currently assaulting have the objective of disrupting our command system. Oathguard squads, do not drag out the fight. Maintain engagement distance and retreat in an orderly manner!
column2: Pasukan elite musuh yang menyerbu sekarang bertujuan mengacaukan sistem komando kita. Regu Oathguard, jangan bertempur berlarut-larut. Jaga jarak tempur dan mundur dengan tertib!

column1: Doll squads, take over the front lines. Activate Backup Plan 14.
column2: Regu Doll, ambil alih garis depan. Aktifkan Rencana Cadangan 14.

column1: (Amidst the fierce crossfire, the Mokosh Oathguards retreat rapidly under the cover of the Dolls.)
column2: (Di tengah baku tembak sengit, Oathguards Mokosh mundur cepat di bawah perlindungan para Doll.)

column1: (I stared intently at the actions of the eerie creatures on the screen, while quickly recalling the battle situation described by Alva and Faelynn, verifying the known situation.)
column2: (Kutatap lekat gerak makhluk-makhluk mengerikan di layar, sambil cepat mengingat kembali situasi tempur yang dijelaskan Alva dan Faelynn, mencocokkannya dengan keadaan yang kutahu.)

column1: (According to what they said, the Wildhunt's individual combat ability is almost equivalent to a high-level Nyto. They excel at group actions and create immense battlefield pressure in a short time through high-speed attacks.)
column2: (Menurut mereka, kemampuan tempur perorangan Wildhunt hampir setara Nyto tingkat tinggi. Mereka unggul dalam gerakan berkelompok dan menciptakan tekanan medan tempur yang luar biasa dalam waktu singkat lewat serangan berkecepatan tinggi.)

column1: The third area defense line on the west front has been breached! The fourth area has been breached—
column2: Garis pertahanan area ketiga di front barat tertembus! Area keempat tertembus—

column1: Commander, what exactly are these monsters?!
column2: Komandan, monster apa sebenarnya mereka ini?!

column1: They are malicious weapons created by immoral people, we won't lose to them.
column2: Mereka senjata jahat buatan orang-orang tak bermoral, kita tidak akan kalah dari mereka.

column1: (Compared to Nytos who possess complete personalities, these 'creatures' do not engage in complex thinking. Their judgment is merely equivalent to AIs without Neural clouds.)
column2: (Dibanding Nyto yang punya kepribadian utuh, 'makhluk' ini tidak melakukan pemikiran rumit. Daya nalarnya cuma setara AI tanpa Neural cloud.)

column1: (Therefore, they are difficult to command and unsuitable for complex missions.)
column2: (Karena itu mereka sulit dikomandoi dan tidak cocok untuk misi yang rumit.)

column1: (In artificially created complex battlefields, they act more upon their hunting instincts, and are used to damage high-value targets on the battlefield, or rely on their three-dimensional mobility to hunt down rear personnel.)
column2: (Di medan tempur rumit yang sengaja dibuat, mereka lebih banyak bertindak menuruti naluri berburu, dipakai untuk merusak sasaran bernilai tinggi di medan tempur, atau mengandalkan kelincahan tiga dimensinya untuk memburu personel di barisan belakang.)

column1: (And in the previous battles, the enemy also seems to have probed our defensive loopholes.)
column2: (Dan dalam pertempuran sebelumnya, musuh sepertinya juga sudah menyelidiki celah pertahanan kami.)

column1: In that case...
column2: Kalau begitu...

column1: Then come.
column2: Silakan datang.

column1: (In the previous defensive battles, we may have indeed exposed some vulnerabilities in our defensive lines.)
column2: (Dalam pertempuran bertahan sebelumnya, kami memang mungkin telah membuka beberapa titik rawan di garis pertahanan.)

column1: (But if we knew where our vulnerabilities were early on, we could naturally take advantage of them.)
column2: (Tapi kalau kami sudah tahu sejak awal di mana titik rawan itu, tentu kami bisa memanfaatkannya.)

column1: Vasily, it's time to try out another one of your little inventions.
column2: Vasily, saatnya mencoba satu lagi penemuan kecilmu.

column1: Um... will that work?
column2: Umm... apa itu akan berhasil?

column1: Wait and see.
column2: Lihat saja nanti.

column1: (At the same time, the Wildhunt had crossed the trenches and defense lines and began to climb Mokosh's dome. Behind them, groups of missiles were launching. The enemy wasn't worried that these high-speed units would be affected; instead, they wanted to use this combination to test our adaptability.)
column2: (Di saat bersamaan, Wildhunt sudah melewati parit dan garis pertahanan lalu mulai memanjat kubah Mokosh. Di belakang mereka, gugusan rudal diluncurkan. Musuh tidak khawatir unit berkecepatan tinggi itu terkena dampaknya; justru mereka ingin memakai kombinasi ini untuk menguji daya adaptasi kami.)

column1: (When the first Wildhunt entered Mokosh city, what greeted it was the fierce bombardment from OTs-14's muzzle. The Wildhunt's lower body turned into debris, but it still attacked OTs-14 until it was completely destroyed.)
column2: (Saat Wildhunt pertama masuk ke kota Mokosh, yang menyambutnya adalah hujan tembakan ganas dari moncong senjata OTs-14. Tubuh bagian bawah Wildhunt itu hancur berkeping, tapi dia tetap menyerang OTs-14 sampai benar-benar musnah.)

column1: (Third-generation Doll squads, The Elmo comprehensive echelon, 404, Monsoon... several Doll squads shuttled among the Wildhunt. Bullets, blades, artillery fire... all available weapons were applied to them.)
column2: (Regu Doll generasi ketiga, eselon gabungan Elmo, 404, Monsoon... beberapa regu Doll berkelebat di antara para Wildhunt. Peluru, bilah, tembakan artileri... semua senjata yang ada dihujankan pada mereka.)

column1: (However, the rapidly moving Wildhunt were like evil spirits, using the sharp claws on their fingertips and the protruding spikes on their bodies to madly tear at everything blocking their way, sprinting into Mokosh city.)
column2: (Namun Wildhunt yang bergerak kilat itu bagai arwah jahat, memakai cakar tajam di ujung jari dan duri-duri yang mencuat di tubuhnya untuk mencabik gila segala yang menghalangi, melesat masuk ke kota Mokosh.)

column1: (Except for Voymastina striking from the air and OTs-14 with higher Frame performance, the other squads still gradually showed signs of decline in the face of the high-speed moving 'mass-produced Nytos'.)
column2: (Kecuali Voymastina yang menghantam dari udara dan OTs-14 yang performa Frame-nya lebih tinggi, regu-regu lain perlahan mulai kewalahan menghadapi 'Nyto produksi massal' yang bergerak secepat itu.)

column1: It seems they want to destroy our command system using a pincer attack from the inside and outside.
column2: Sepertinya mereka mau menghancurkan sistem komando kita lewat serangan jepit dari dalam dan luar.

column1: All squads, pay attention. The Wildhunt lacks basic battlefield judgment capabilities and cannot perform complex tactical thinking.
column2: Seluruh regu, perhatian. Wildhunt tidak punya kemampuan menilai medan tempur secara mendasar dan tidak bisa berpikir taktis yang rumit.

column1: Block them, and at the same time, everyone prepare your sonic defenses.
column2: Tahan mereka, dan sekaligus, semuanya siapkan pertahanan terhadap gelombang suara.

column1: Understood!
column2: Dimengerti!

column1: (With the cooperation of the Doll squads, the Wildhunt swarms charging everywhere on the battlefield were intercepted one by one, and the speed of the dark shadows' impact gradually slowed down.)
column2: (Berkat kerja sama regu Doll, kawanan Wildhunt yang menerjang ke segala arah di medan tempur dicegat satu per satu, dan laju hantaman bayangan gelap itu perlahan melambat.)

column1: (But, this is far from enough.)
column2: (Tapi ini masih jauh dari cukup.)

column1: (Although the Wildhunt were surrounded in batches, relying solely on the Dolls' movement speed, it was even more difficult to further restrict the Wildhunt's actions.)
column2: (Meski para Wildhunt dikepung bergelombang, hanya mengandalkan kecepatan gerak para Doll, makin sulit membatasi gerak mereka lebih jauh.)

column1: Tch... Belka, Mechty, hold off the attack on the west side!
column2: Cih... Belka, Mechty, tahan serangan di sisi barat!

column1: Ugh...! Monsoon Squad, increase Remolding Pattern power! We can't let these monsters break through the defense line!
column2: Ugh...! Monsoon Squad, naikkan daya Remolding Pattern! Kita tidak boleh membiarkan monster-monster ini menembus garis pertahanan!

column1: (Fires broke out all over Mokosh for a time. Many Wildhunt were shattered by Dolls who activated their Remolding Patterns, but there were still several Wildhunt dashing through the streets, attempting to break through the Dolls' defense line.)
column2: (Api berkobar di seantero Mokosh untuk sesaat. Banyak Wildhunt hancur berkeping oleh para Doll yang mengaktifkan Remolding Pattern, tapi masih ada beberapa Wildhunt yang melesat di jalanan, berusaha menembus garis pertahanan para Doll.)

column1: (We can't let these monsters penetrate any deeper. I turned my gaze back to Vasily—and nodded.)
column2: (Kami tidak boleh membiarkan monster-monster ini menembus lebih dalam. Kualihkan pandangan kembali ke Vasily—dan kuangguk.)

column1: Turn off all communications in 30 seconds and activate the "Horn System". Repeat: Turn off all communications and activate the "Horn System".
column2: Matikan semua komunikasi dalam 30 detik dan aktifkan "Horn System". Kuulangi: matikan semua komunikasi dan aktifkan "Horn System".

column1: (Under Vasily's command, soon, the entire city of Mokosh fell silent.)
column2: (Di bawah komando Vasily, tak lama kemudian, seluruh kota Mokosh senyap.)

column1: (Because of the sudden loud buzzing sound, everyone soon uncontrollably held their heads and pressed their eardrums.)
column2: (Karena dengung keras yang tiba-tiba itu, semua orang sebentar kemudian memegangi kepala dan menekan gendang telinganya tanpa bisa menahan diri.)

column1: (One of the defense systems deployed in Mokosh is this sonic weapon defense line I had Vasily build—and according to Faelynn and the others' reports, this is especially effective against the Wildhunt.)
column2: (Salah satu sistem pertahanan yang dipasang di Mokosh adalah garis pertahanan senjata gelombang suara yang kuminta Vasily bangun—dan menurut laporan Faelynn dan yang lain, ini sangat ampuh melawan Wildhunt.)

column1: (A minute later, communications reopened, and we saw the Wildhunt moving noticeably slower, with large amounts of tissue fluid pouring out. Their internal neural structures were damaged, allowing the Dolls to suppress them.)
column2: (Semenit kemudian, komunikasi dibuka lagi, dan kami melihat para Wildhunt bergerak jelas lebih lambat, dengan cairan jaringan mengucur deras. Struktur saraf di dalam tubuh mereka rusak, sehingga para Doll bisa menekan mereka.)

column1: (After the damage exceeded the critical point, the Wildhunt did not retreat—but chose to further assault into Mokosh city.)
column2: (Setelah kerusakannya melewati titik kritis, para Wildhunt tidak mundur—melainkan memilih menyerbu lebih jauh ke dalam kota Mokosh.)

column1: (However, with both their sensors and nerves damaged, their ability to dominate the terrain also dropped significantly.)
column2: (Namun dengan sensor dan saraf yang sama-sama rusak, kemampuan mereka menguasai medan pun anjlok drastis.)

column1: Oathguards, return to original defense positions and assist the Doll squads in clearing the Wildhunt.
column2: Oathguards, kembali ke posisi pertahanan semula dan bantu regu Doll membersihkan Wildhunt.

column1: All squads, attention, cooperate with the Oathguards' extermination mission.
column2: Seluruh regu, perhatian, dukung misi pembasmian bersama Oathguards.

column1: The optimal combat time is 5 minutes. Within 5 minutes, annihilate all Wildhunt that have entered Mokosh!
column2: Waktu tempur optimalnya 5 menit. Dalam 5 menit, musnahkan semua Wildhunt yang sudah masuk Mokosh!

column1: Got it!
column2: Siap!
